objective: Sincronizador: diagnosticar por qué el nuevo histórico Comercial Sep 2026 queda en 0% en 130MID. Consultar últimos trabajos comercial_range_batch y el lock sync_comercial_v2, incluyendo antigüedad del heartbeat. Solo lectura, sin modificar datos ni Producción.

queries.name: latest_range_jobs
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 5 ResyncLogID, Estado, Mensaje, UnidadCodigo, RegistrosAfectados, SolicitadoPor, FechaEjecucion, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.status') AS payload_status, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.fecha_inicio') AS fecha_inicio, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.fecha_fin') AS fecha_fin, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_unit') AS current_unit, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_block') AS current_block, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_phase') AS current_phase, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.percent_complete') AS percent_complete, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.updated_at_utc') AS updated_at_utc, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.successful_steps') AS successful_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.failed_steps') AS failed_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.completed_steps') AS completed_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.total_steps') AS total_steps FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_ResyncLog WHERE TipoSync='comercial_range_batch' ORDER BY ResyncLogID DESC

queries.name: canonical_sync_lock
queries.sql: SELECT JobName, OwnerID, AcquiredAt, HeartbeatAt, LockUntil, DATEDIFF(SECOND, HeartbeatAt, SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS heartbeat_age_seconds, DATEDIFF(SECOND, SYSUTCDATETIME(), LockUntil) AS seconds_until_expiry FROM dbo.Scheduler_DistributedLocks WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2'
